sections.description:
Turn your Google Business Profile into a sales engine for your WordPress store

Always Accurate, Always Trusted

Keep your business details up to date everywhere — on your WordPress site and your Google Business Profile. No more outdated hours or missing information. Synoveo ensures customers always find you with complete, verified, and current details.

Turn Google Visitors Into Paying Customers

Your verified Google My Business listing builds instant trust and drives conversions. Synoveo turns your Google presence into a live marketing channel that captures local buyers searching “near me”.

Own Your Local Search Results

Synoveo automatically keeps your Google Maps and Business Profile optimized, so your business appears first when nearby customers search for what you offer. No manual updates. No SEO agencies. Just effortless, consistent visibility.

Built for Real Business Results

Synoveo connects WordPress, WooCommerce, and your favorite plugins (Yoast, Rank Math, Amelia Booking, Bookly) to your verified Google Business Profile using the official API — ensuring real, safe, and automatic synchronization.

What Makes Synoveo Different:

Synoveo uses official Google Business Profile API access to connect directly to Google’s systems. This direct integration provides reliable synchronization and up-to-date business information.

Your Competitive Advantage:
* Instant market authority — Customers see a business that’s always current and professional

* Zero maintenance overhead — Your business runs itself online while you focus on serving customers

sections.installation:
5-Minute Setup (No Technical Skills Required):

  1. Install Synoveo from your WordPress admin (Plugins → Add New → Search “Synoveo”)
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Synoveo in your WordPress menu
  4. Click “Connect to Google Business Profile”
  5. Authorize Synoveo (secure, no passwords shared)
  6. Done! Your Google Business Profile will update automatically
sections.faq:
How does Synoveo’s Google API integration work?

Google Business Profile API requires special approval and enterprise-grade security. Synoveo meets Google’s requirements for official API access, providing a reliable connection to your Google Business Profile.

How does Synoveo help my business make more money?

When customers search for businesses like yours, they choose the ones that look current, professional, and trustworthy. Synoveo ensures your business always appears this way, automatically. You capture more customers while competitors lose them to outdated listings.

How much time can Synoveo save?

Many business owners spend 30-60 minutes per week updating their Google Business Profile manually. Synoveo automates this process, helping you maintain consistent information without manual updates.

Is my Google account safe with Synoveo?

Absolutely! Synoveo uses Google’s official OAuth 2.0 system (the same “Sign in with Google” you see on other websites). We never store your Google password or access your personal information. You can disconnect anytime from your Google account settings.

Do I need technical knowledge?

Not at all! Synoveo is designed for business owners, not developers. The setup takes 5 minutes with simple click-by-click instructions. Once connected, everything happens automatically.

Will this work with my existing plugins?

Yes! Synoveo automatically detects and works with 6+ popular plugins including WooCommerce, Amelia Booking, Bookly, Booking Calendar, Simply Schedule Appointments, and WP Booking System. If you use supported plugins, Synoveo will find them automatically and sync your data.

What if I don’t have WooCommerce or booking plugins?

Synoveo still helps! It will sync your basic business information, hours, and contact details to Google Business Profile. This alone helps customers find you and increases your local search ranking.

How often does Synoveo update my Google Business Profile?

The free Lite version syncs up to 3 times per week (perfect for most small businesses). Professional plans (coming soon) will offer daily or real-time syncing for high-volume businesses.

Can I see what Synoveo is doing?

Yes! Synoveo provides a detailed dashboard showing:
* What information was synced
* When the last sync happened
* How many syncs you have remaining
* What plugins were detected
* Complete activity logs

What happens if I disconnect Synoveo?

You can disconnect anytime with zero consequences:
* Your Google Business Profile keeps all the information Synoveo synced
* Your WordPress website is completely unaffected
* No data is lost or damaged
* You can reconnect later if you want

Does Synoveo work with my theme?

Yes! Synoveo works with any WordPress theme. It doesn’t change how your website looks – it only helps Google show accurate information about your business to potential customers.
